shared_elements: bird with hooked beak in profile
raised relief carving of figures against a plain ground
band or register organizing the composition
justification: Both surfaces show profile creatures in low relief, including a bird-like head with a hooked beak, and both use a register or band to organise the field, but these are generic correspondences. A shows a stacked assembly of small schematic animals (quadrupeds, birds, a snake-like form) with no single dominant actor, whereas B shows one large, anatomically detailed anthropomorphic figure with elaborate feathered wings, garment, raised hand and a handled bucket — a specific figural scheme wholly absent from A.
